question: Which DNS resource record type supports IPv6 addresses and is equivalent to an IPv4 A record?

contains_any:
The DNS AAAA resource record types support IPv6 addresses and are equivalent to an A
address record in IPv4.

question: What does GLBP MD5 authentication do with an incoming packet whose hash does not match the locally generated hash?

contains_any:
A keyed hash of an incoming packet is generated and, if the hash within the
incoming packet does not match the generated hash, the packet is ignored.

question: Why group BGP neighbors with the same update policies into a peer group?

contains_any:
Neighbors with the same update policies can be
grouped into peer groups to simplify configuration and to make updating more efficient.

question: Which EIGRP packet-header bit does a newly active switch use to signal an NSF restart and prevent neighbors from resetting the adjacency?

contains_any:
To prevent an adjacency reset by the neighbors, the new active switch uses a new Restart (RS) bit in the
EIGRP packet header to show the restart.

question: Which OSPF packet types carry additional data in a dedicated link-local signaling TLV block?

contains_any:
Link-local signaling provides a mechanism to append additional data to OSPF hello and database description
packets by using a dedicated link-local signaling data block (a TLV structure).
